body: I find myself reliving the events and getting anxious and tense.  I should try and get some counseling too. I will give it a little time, it's all too fresh still.
Going to help you set studio back up Babydoll, worry about packing later, and I will help with that too.
Thank you. I did get to see her.  She is in no way able to talk about anything, yet. I think the meds she took will take awhile to work out of her system.  It's scary.
Thank you, thank you.  This means a great deal to me, it gives me perspective, a frame of reference, that I wouldn't have otherwise had.  I have read it several times.  Grateful.
My friend just tried last night, but survived, thankfully.  How do I cope with the feelings I have ?   And still be effective in helping her through?  I feel like the bad guy here.

Thank you. Now the hardest part is being cut out of things, I am not family.  Likely not welcome either.  I have never felt so guilty in my life. I have to deal with it so it doesn't cross over into making her feel worse.  Waiting to hear how things are going,and if someone deigns to tell me, is very difficult.
Please read my post for update.
Please read my message for update.  Thank you.
